errors.text: The proposed Mo/Re-modified refractory alloy and SPD/annealing route do not reconstruct the CoCrFeNiTi powder-metallurgy route based on high-energy ball milling followed by spark plasma sintering.

Minor Mo/Re additions are not supported as a means of converting a strongly BCC refractory alloy such as NbMoTaWVTi into a stable FCC+BCC dual solid solution; Mo is already a principal constituent of the example alloy.

The negative-misfit and N-type rafting argument is drawn from gamma/gamma-prime precipitation-strengthened alloys and presupposes a coherent precipitate architecture rather than the requested intermetallic-free FCC+BCC solid-solution constitution.

None of the cited evidence directly demonstrates the combined result of sub-50 nm grains, FCC+BCC solid solutions, and suppressed intermetallic formation in the proposed refractory composition and processing window.
Processing conditions are not quantitatively defined sufficiently to reproduce the proposed phase constitution or grain size.
